natural: Pulling up seedlings to help them grow

meaning.en: To spoil things through impatience; forcing growth and doing harm.
meaning.zh: 把苗拔起来帮助它生长。比喻违反事物的发展规律，急于求成，反而坏事。

examples.zh: 让三岁孩子学微积分，简直是拔苗助长。
examples.en: Making a three-year-old learn calculus is forcing things and doing more harm than good.

examples.zh: 教育要循序渐进，不能拔苗助长。
examples.en: Education must be gradual — you can't force growth.

story.en: A farmer from Song, worried his seedlings were growing too slowly, pulled each one up a little. He came home exhausted and said he had helped them grow. His son ran to look — the seedlings had all withered.
story.zh: 宋国有人嫌禾苗长得慢，就一棵棵往上拔，回家说："今日病矣！予助苗长矣！"其子去看，苗都枯死了。

usage.en: Predicate or object. 长 is zhǎng. The original form is 揠苗助长.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语。"长"读 zhǎng。原作"揠苗助长"。

natural: Recklessly belittling oneself

meaning.en: To underestimate or belittle oneself.
meaning.zh: 过分看轻自己，形容自卑。

examples.zh: 你很有才华，不要妄自菲薄。
examples.en: You're very talented — don't sell yourself short.

examples.zh: 我们既不能妄自尊大，也不能妄自菲薄。
examples.en: We should neither overrate ourselves nor sell ourselves short.

story.en: In his famous memorial before marching north, Zhuge Liang urged the young emperor "not to belittle yourself recklessly or use improper analogies" (不宜妄自菲薄，引喻失义).
story.zh: 诸葛亮《出师表》："不宜妄自菲薄，引喻失义，以塞忠谏之路也。"

usage.en: Predicate. Usually negated as advice. 菲 is fěi.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用否定劝勉。"菲"读 fěi。

natural: Trying to be clever and ending up clumsy

meaning.en: To try to be clever and end up making a mess of things.
meaning.zh: 本想耍弄聪明，结果做了蠢事。

examples.zh: 他想走捷径，结果弄巧成拙。
examples.en: He tried to take a shortcut and it backfired.

examples.zh: 过度修图反而弄巧成拙，照片显得很假。
examples.en: Over-editing backfired — the photo looks fake.

usage.en: Predicate.

synonyms: 拍马屁拍到蹄子上——倒挨一脚

natural: Pavilions, terraces, towers and halls

meaning.en: The pavilions, terraces and towers of a traditional Chinese garden or palace.
meaning.zh: 泛指供游玩、观赏的各种建筑物。

examples.zh: 苏州园林里亭台楼阁错落有致。
examples.en: The pavilions and towers of Suzhou's gardens are artfully arranged.

examples.zh: 湖边的亭台楼阁倒映在水中。
examples.en: The lakeside pavilions are reflected in the water.

usage.en: Noun phrase; a cultural set of four building types.

natural: So close there is no gap between them

meaning.en: Very close and intimate; inseparable.
meaning.zh: 关系亲密，没有隔阂。

examples.zh: 这对双胞胎亲密无间。
examples.en: The twins are inseparable.

examples.zh: 两国保持着亲密无间的合作。
examples.en: The two countries maintain very close cooperation.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 间 is jiàn (gap).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。"间"读 jiàn。

natural: So firm it cannot be destroyed

meaning.en: Indestructible; impregnable.
meaning.zh: 非常坚固，摧毁不了。

examples.zh: 他们的友谊坚不可摧。
examples.en: Their friendship is unbreakable.

examples.zh: 这座城堡号称坚不可摧。
examples.en: The castle was said to be impregnable.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.

natural: Heavenly flowers raining down

meaning.en: To talk something up extravagantly; exaggerated and unrealistic.
meaning.zh: 形容说话动听，但多为夸张不切实际。

examples.zh: 推销员把产品说得天花乱坠。
examples.en: The salesman made the product sound incredible.

examples.zh: 不管广告说得多么天花乱坠，都要理性消费。
examples.en: However amazing the ads make it sound, be sensible about spending.

usage.en: Complement (说得天花乱坠). From a Buddhist legend that a monk preached so movingly that heavenly flowers rained down.
usage.zh: 多作补语。源自佛教传说：法师讲经感动上天，天花纷纷落下。

natural: Walking when he walks, hurrying when he hurries

meaning.en: To slavishly imitate; to follow someone's every move.
meaning.zh: 别人走也走，别人跑也跑。比喻没有主张，或为讨好而事事模仿、追随别人。

examples.zh: 做设计不能亦步亦趋地模仿别人。
examples.en: In design you can't just copy others slavishly.

examples.zh: 小国不必对大国亦步亦趋。
examples.en: Small countries needn't follow every move of the big powers.

story.en: Yan Hui said to Confucius: "When you walk, I walk; when you hurry, I hurry; when you run, I run — but when you dash off leaving no dust, I can only stare after you."
story.zh: 颜渊问于仲尼曰："夫子步亦步，夫子趋亦趋，夫子驰亦驰；夫子奔逸绝尘，而回瞠若乎后矣！"

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial.

natural: Green plums and bamboo horses

meaning.en: Childhood sweethearts; friends who grew up together.
meaning.zh: 形容小儿女天真无邪玩耍的样子。后指男女幼时亲密无间。

equivalents: known each other since they were kids

examples.zh: 他们是青梅竹马，后来结了婚。
examples.en: They were childhood sweethearts and later married.

examples.zh: 她和青梅竹马的好友多年没见了。
examples.en: She hasn't seen her childhood friend in years.

story.en: Li Bai's poem in a young wife's voice recalls childhood: "You came riding a bamboo horse, circling the well-rail, playing with green plums" (郎骑竹马来，绕床弄青梅).
story.zh: 李白《长干行》："郎骑竹马来，绕床弄青梅。同居长干里，两小无嫌猜。"

usage.en: Subject, object or attributive. Often with 两小无猜.
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语、定语，常与"两小无猜"连用。

natural: Content with things as they are

meaning.en: Content with the status quo; unwilling to change or improve.
meaning.zh: 满足于目前的状况，不求进取。

examples.zh: 年轻人不能安于现状，要不断学习。
examples.en: Young people mustn't get complacent — keep learning.

examples.zh: 公司安于现状，结果被对手超越。
examples.en: The company stayed in its comfort zone and was overtaken by rivals.

usage.en: Predicate. Usually critical.

natural: Talent in abundance

meaning.en: A wealth of talent.
meaning.zh: 形容有才能的人很多。

examples.zh: 这所大学人才济济。
examples.en: The university has a wealth of talent.

examples.zh: 公司研发部人才济济，创新能力很强。
examples.en: The R&D department is full of talented people and very innovative.

usage.en: Predicate. 济济 is jǐjǐ (not jìjì).
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"济济"读 jǐ jǐ。

antonyms: 蜀中无大将，廖化作先锋

natural: The blame comes from oneself

meaning.en: To have only oneself to blame; brought it on oneself.
meaning.zh: 灾祸或罪过是自己招来的。

equivalents: made one's bed and must lie in it

examples.zh: 他酒后驾车被抓，完全是咎由自取。
examples.en: He was caught drink-driving and has only himself to blame.

examples.zh: 这家公司破产是咎由自取。
examples.en: The company brought its bankruptcy on itself.

usage.en: Predicate. 咎 is jiù.

natural: What those above do, those below copy

meaning.en: Subordinates follow the example of their superiors (usually bad).
meaning.zh: 上面的人怎么做，下面的人就跟着怎么做（多指坏的）。

equivalents: the fish rots from the head
set the tone from the top

examples.zh: 领导带头迟到，上行下效，员工也不守时了。
examples.en: The boss is always late, so the staff follow suit — monkey see, monkey do.

examples.zh: 父母是孩子的榜样，上行下效。
examples.en: Parents are role models — children copy what they do.

story.en: The Han text explains teaching (教) as imitation (效): "those above do it, and those below imitate it" (上为之，下效之).
story.zh: 班固《白虎通》："教者，效也，上为之，下效之。"

usage.en: Predicate. Often about bad examples.

natural: Red lanterns and green wine

meaning.en: The glitter of nightlife; a life of decadent pleasure.
meaning.zh: 形容寻欢作乐的腐化生活，也形容都市夜生活繁华。

examples.zh: 他迷失在城市的灯红酒绿中。
examples.en: He lost himself in the city's bright lights.

examples.zh: 有些官员整天出入灯红酒绿的场所。
examples.en: Some officials spend all their time in nightclubs and bars.

usage.en: Attributive or object. Usually implies decadence.
usage.zh: 多作定语、宾语，多含贬义。

natural: Wherever it goes, all collapse before it

meaning.en: Invincible; sweeping all before one.
meaning.zh: 力量所到之处，敌人纷纷溃败。比喻力量强大，所向无敌。

examples.zh: 这支球队本赛季所向披靡，未尝一败。
examples.en: The team has swept all before it this season, unbeaten.

examples.zh: 新产品上市后所向披靡，迅速占领了市场。
examples.en: After launch the new product was unbeatable and quickly took over the market.

usage.en: Predicate. 靡 is mǐ.

antonyms: 一切反动派都是纸老虎

natural: Words flickering and wavering

meaning.en: To be evasive; to speak vaguely to avoid the truth.
meaning.zh: 说话吞吞吐吐，不肯透露真相或回避要害问题。

examples.zh: 问他钱去哪儿了，他闪烁其词。
examples.en: When asked where the money went, he was evasive.

examples.zh: 发言人对这个问题闪烁其词。
examples.en: The spokesperson hedged on the question.

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: Eating in the wind and sleeping in the dew

meaning.en: To endure the hardships of travel or outdoor life.
meaning.zh: 在风里吃饭，在露天睡觉。形容旅途或野外生活的艰苦。

examples.zh: 勘探队员风餐露宿，在沙漠里工作了半年。
examples.en: The survey team roughed it in the desert for six months.

examples.zh: 他骑车环游中国，一路风餐露宿。
examples.en: He cycled around China, sleeping rough along the way.

usage.en: Predicate. 宿 is sù.

natural: A rat crossing the street

meaning.en: Someone universally hated.
meaning.zh: 比喻人人痛恨的人或事物。

examples.zh: 骗子成了过街老鼠，人人喊打。
examples.en: The con man became a pariah, hated by all.

examples.zh: 假货在这里就像过街老鼠。
examples.en: Fakes here are universally loathed.

usage.en: Usually in 过街老鼠，人人喊打 (a rat crossing the street — everyone shouts "kill it").
usage.zh: 常说"过街老鼠，人人喊打"。

natural: Drinking poison to quench thirst

meaning.en: A short-term fix that causes disaster later.
meaning.zh: 喝毒酒来解渴。比喻用错误的办法解决眼前困难，不顾严重后果。

equivalents: a cure worse than the disease

examples.zh: 借高利贷还债无异于饮鸩止渴。
examples.en: Borrowing from loan sharks to pay off debts is a cure worse than the disease.

examples.zh: 靠降价抢市场是饮鸩止渴。
examples.en: Slashing prices to win market share is a short-term fix that will backfire.

story.en: Huo Xu wrote that a wrong remedy is "like curing hunger with aconite, or quenching thirst with zhen poison — before they reach the stomach, the throat is already cut off".
story.zh: 《后汉书·霍谞传》："譬犹疗饥于附子，止渴于鸩毒，未入肠胃，已绝咽喉。"

usage.en: Predicate or object. 鸩 is zhèn (a legendary poison bird).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语。"鸩"读 zhèn。

natural: An incompetent piper making up the numbers

meaning.en: To pass oneself off as competent; to make up the numbers without real ability.
meaning.zh: 不会吹竽的人混在吹竽的队伍里充数。比喻无本领的冒充有本领，次货冒充好货。

examples.zh: 团队里不能有人滥竽充数。
examples.en: No one on the team can just make up the numbers.

examples.zh: 这本书有些章节是滥竽充数的。
examples.en: Some chapters of this book are just padding.

story.en: King Xuan of Qi liked to hear the yu pipe played by 300 musicians together. Mr Nanguo, who couldn't play, joined in and drew a salary. When the next king wanted solos, Mr Nanguo fled.
story.zh: 齐宣王喜欢听三百人合奏竽，南郭先生不会吹也混在其中。齐湣王即位后喜欢听独奏，南郭先生只好逃走。

date.en: end of Warring States, 3rd c. BC

usage.en: Predicate. Also used modestly of oneself (我只是滥竽充数).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也可用作自谦。

natural: The five grains ripening in abundance

meaning.en: A bumper harvest of all crops.
meaning.zh: 指年成好，粮食丰收。

examples.zh: 今年风调雨顺，五谷丰登。
examples.en: The weather was kind this year, and there was a bumper harvest.

examples.zh: 春节对联上写着"五谷丰登"。
examples.en: The Spring Festival couplet reads "a bumper harvest".

usage.en: Predicate. Common in New Year wishes, often with 六畜兴旺.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"六畜兴旺"连用。

natural: Sitting and discussing principles

meaning.en: To talk theory without taking action.
meaning.zh: 原指坐着议论政事。后泛指空谈大道理，不付诸行动。

equivalents: talk the talk but not walk the walk

examples.zh: 坐而论道不如起而行之。
examples.en: Better to get up and act than to sit and talk.

examples.zh: 解决问题不能坐而论道，要拿出办法。
examples.en: You can't solve problems by theorising — come up with solutions.

story.en: The Rites of Zhou: "Those who sit and discuss the Way are called kings and dukes; those who rise and carry it out are called officers" (坐而论道，谓之王公；作而行之，谓之士大夫).
story.zh: 《周礼·考工记》："坐而论道，谓之王公；作而行之，谓之士大夫。"

usage.en: Predicate. Often contrasted with 起而行之.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"起而行之"对举。

natural: Not enough to tip the scales

meaning.en: Of no importance; insignificant.
meaning.zh: 无关紧要，不值得重视。

examples.zh: 这只是一个无足轻重的小错误。
examples.en: It's just an insignificant little mistake.

examples.zh: 在他眼里，我的意见无足轻重。
examples.en: In his eyes, my opinion counts for nothing.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.

synonyms: 大年三十晚上打兔子——有你不多，没你不少

natural: Clothes ragged and tattered

meaning.en: Dressed in rags.
meaning.zh: 衣服破破烂烂。

examples.zh: 一个衣衫褴褛的老人坐在路边。
examples.en: An old man in rags sat by the roadside.

examples.zh: 难民们衣衫褴褛，饥寒交迫。
examples.en: The refugees were in tatters, cold and hungry.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 褴褛 is lánlǚ.

natural: Pushing over mountains and overturning seas

meaning.en: Overwhelming; with irresistible force.
meaning.zh: 推开高山，翻倒大海。形容力量强盛，声势浩大。

examples.zh: 观众的掌声排山倒海般响起。
examples.en: The audience's applause thundered like a tidal wave.

examples.zh: 改革的浪潮以排山倒海之势席卷全国。
examples.en: The wave of reform swept the country with overwhelming force.

usage.en: Attributive or adverbial (排山倒海般/之势).
